benefits.titleEn: Talk naturally about heat and temperature
benefits.zh: cool down 可以描述人、食物、飲品、房間和機器變得沒那麼熱。
benefits.en: Cool down can describe people, food, drinks, rooms and machines becoming less hot.

benefits.zh: cool off 可以表示某人在爭吵或不快事件後需要時間冷靜下來。
benefits.en: Cool off can show that someone needs time to become calmer after an argument or upsetting event.

benefits.titleZh: 描述感情和興趣的變化
benefits.zh: cool off 也可以描述友誼、感情或興趣逐漸減退。
benefits.en: Cool off can also describe a friendship, relationship or interest becoming less strong.

benefits.titleZh: 理解同一表達在不同情境中的意思
benefits.titleEn: Understand the same expression in different situations
benefits.zh: 認識 cool off 的不同意思，可以幫助你理解關於感情和怒氣的對話。
benefits.en: Knowing the different meanings of cool off helps you understand conversations about both relationships and anger.
